selection: Filter before measuring; within each eligible repository sort SHA256(seed + NUL + instance_id); round-robin across lexicographically sorted repositories until 30 cases. Never selected using Kiro/model outcomes.

source_projection.preserved: Original source bytes, including comments and inline tests in production files. All files normalized to0644. No separate tests/docs/fixtures/.git/dependencies/build output.
source_projection.limits: Whole retained production projection, no outcome-based trimming to fit Scout limits. Bounded Scout may explicitly report partial scans.

prompt_data: Original issue text only plus fixed read-only diagnosis instructions. No hints, reference patch, added tests, FAIL_TO_PASS identifiers, or evaluation scripts supplied.
scoring_scope: Reference patch locations are an imperfect proxy; multiple valid diagnoses may exist. No project execution and no claim of issue repair or test-validated correctness. Pure insertions use at most three old lines before and two after their anchor; new-only files are reported separately.
private_read_denial: Benchmark subprocesses should deny all file reads to this dataset/private directory, which contains all archives/raw task data/reference patches.
